spans.text: Carriage F02, Intercontinental Railway train "Future".
Susanna slowly pushes her cart down the aisle.
She is serving all kinds of food and drinks to passengers who don't have either the time or the desire to visit the dining carriage.
Instructor Lyudmila, what would you like? Wine or tea? There's also sandwiches and veal steaks.
Instructor Lyudmila checks her watch, then she promptly gets to her feet.
What kind of carriage is F09?
Carriage F09 is the dining carriage of this service. It is also equipped with a bar.
However, a tequila party is about to take place there, and those without an invitation won't be able to access the carriage for the duration of the party.
Which is why I have prepared some food and drinks beforehand.
If you require anything special, you could hand me a list, and I will do my best to satisfy your needs.
...No thanks.
Lyudmila turns down Susanna's hospitality flatly and just walks away in the direction of Carriage 9. As Susanna watches her leave, she suddenly comes to a realization.
I see...
She's also boarding the Colt Express...
Looks like Maggie has caught a big fish this time. How much will a customer from the first-class carriage spend?
Susanna thinks about the money that will shortly be hers and can't help but grin.
But she immediately reverts back to her sweet customer-service smile and proceeds to the next seat.
Ms. Valeriya, here is the botrytized wine that you ordered.
Carriage F09, Intercontinental Railway train "Future".
Lyudmila steps into the carriage and scans the space coolly.
After a two-second pause, she makes for an empty table and sits down.
The table is very close to the bar. The music is a bit too loud, so most customers tend to stay away.
...But the perk of sitting at this table is having an unobstructed view of everyone in the entire carriage.
Lyudmila looks down at her watch and silently counts down.
...Five more seconds.
She looks at the Doll sitting right in front of the bar.
As if sensing her gaze, the Doll looks this way.
Four.
Three.
After a sharp clink, the Doll raises her glass up high. Amber-colored whiskey swirls in the glass, refracting the light.
It is both brilliant and dazzling.
Two.
Tequila is on me tonight.
The woman beams. Lyudmila wonders if that was directed at her.
One.
Zero.
Attention, dear passengers.
The Future has entered a tunnel.
Attention, dear passengers...
The... Fu... ture...
It's as if the train has entered a black hole. The light disappears in an instant, and the voice in the broadcast gradually distorts and dissolves into white noise.
Whoosh—
The train is still whizzing through the tunnel. The darkness outside the windows persist.
White mist starts rolling in from all directions and rising from under Lyudmila's seat.
Accompanied by the mist is the sound of some kind of creepy... nursery rhyme.
From beneath Hell, I gaze up at Heaven
A crystal glass of Tequila Slammer
Reflects a soul in its truest form
Fox raises this glass of Tequila Slammer
Her heart and lungs are set aflame
Desires and deception intertwine
The devil exposes the angel's hypocrisy
The liquor cleanses the blood vessels
Here are two Tequila Slammers
One for Satan
And one for myself
...The voice slowly fades away, and the mist disperses.
Rustle... A smear of light dispels the darkness.
A gaslamp suddenly appears on the table in front of Lyudmila.
Its flickering flame illuminates a small area around it.
I see...
So this is the "Colt Express"—a Level II neural space disguised as a steam locomotive.
The intercontinental train has just exited the tunnel.
Inside Carriage 9 of the Future, Lyudmila picks up a glass of tequila. Her surroundings remain exactly the same as before the train had entered the tunnel.
Meanwhile, in the eerie antique carriage on board the Colt Express, a Doll whose face is obscured is now sitting opposite her.
...So this is the Colt Express?
This doesn't sound like the manager!
You should at least answer me out of basic courtesy.
Indeed.
As the manager, shouldn't you be a bit more hospitable?
First of all, you should confirm whether I am even the manager. Then you can ask why I'm not being hospitable. And finally, not all business owners are friendly.
...So why are you not hospitable?
...Don't make me repeat myself.
All the more reason why you should explain this properly.
You communicate to make yourself understood, not only when it suits you.
You will lose out on a lot of business if you talk like this.
...Fortunately for you, I'm in a good mood right now.
Lyudmila takes a deep breath.
Fortunately for YOU, I'm in a good mood.
Clink.
A sharp noise suddenly interrupts the conversation that is becoming increasingly nonsensical.
Apologies, dear customers.
A Doll has appeared out of thin air. Lyudmila's brow furrows.
"Dear customers"?
Sorry to have kept you waiting. Allow me to introduce myself.
I am the manager of the Colt Express. You may call me... Queen of Hearts.
..."Queen of Hearts".
That's right.
Miss Queen of Hearts snaps her fingers with a smile. Then she takes down a bottle of tequila from the cabinet behind her and pours out three glasses.
I'm sure the two of you already have a certain level of understanding of what the Colt Express offers.
This is the most secure and trustworthy trading hub for Dolls.
You can buy and sell pretty much anything you want here.
Miss Queen of Hearts pauses briefly.
—But before that, I need to check your tickets.
Please forgive me, but this is a mandatory procedure... I am a rule-abiding trader, after all.
After a few seconds of silence, Lyudmila fishes out an invitation from her pocket.
When the invitation lands on the wooden table, it transforms into a playing card—ace of spades.
The Doll with the obscured face also produces her invitation, which turns into a three of clubs.
Queen of Hearts stares at the two cards with narrowed eyes.
She examines them in silence...
After a while, she finally breaks into a smile and claps her hands. Her tone is now very genial.
Wonderful, everything appears to be in order.
We can get down to business. What say you?
Lyudmila is just about to speak, but the other Doll beats her to it.
Sure, fine by me.
Splendid. Then let's start with the introductions again.
—Welcome aboard the Colt Express.
